entities.summary: Andorra is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Andorra la Vella. Official languages include Catalan. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional diarchy (co-principality). Population: approximately 0.1 million. Area: 468 km².
